# David Benn

David Benn has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-benn#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/david-benn/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hEP_epOeeHU)

David Benn has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 1](https://flow.je/elections/district-1). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/21/call-for-action-on-spending-as-candidate-stands-again-after-2022-near-miss/)\]
